SHIBA PRASAD MAJHI Bengaluru, India | +91-9778886824 | @www.linkedin.com/in/shibamajhi | spmajhi@gmail.com

SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST | PMP Payment Transformation|ISO20022 Migration| CBPR+ |SWIFT|SEPA

A Business Analyst professional with over 13 years of experience in payments solutions and financial systems enhancement, expert in Agile methodologies and stakeholder management. Key achievements include managing projects worth over $1 million annually with early completion and spearheading the delivery ISO 20022 migration for 25 markets. Seeking a Senior Product Owner– Payments and Digital Banking position, where I bring my expertise in payment transformation and program execution to support your mission of delivering complex, mission-critical payment initiatives across digital banking platforms.

EXPERIENCE

Standard Chartered Global Business Services, Bengaluru Senior Business Analyst

June 2017 - June 2026



Spearheaded the global ISO 20022 migration across 25 markets under the CBPR+ initiative, supporting message transformation, business readiness, and delivery governance while achieving 99.9% straight-through processing.

Drove end-to-end business analysis and product delivery for cross-border payments initiatives, translating business requirements into scalable solutions across payment processing and regulatory landscapes. • Architected cross-border P2P payment rails using Visa Direct and Mastercard Send, reducing corridor transaction cost from $50 to $1 through International ACH enablement across 40+ global corridors.

Directed the Malaysia Real-Time Retail Payments Platform product stream, delivering Direct Credit, P2P, and Request-to-Pay(RTP) capabilities through phased MVP releases over a three-year transformation roadmap. • Managed end-to-end SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle activities for payment product implementations, ensuring

alignment between business requirements, testing outcomes, and production readiness.

Applied strong expertise in SWIFT architecture and ISO 20022 standards to support message mapping, payment flow analysis, and design decisions across cross-border payment programs.

Drove process transformation and automation initiatives that improved payment efficiency, strengthened



controls, and enhanced client satisfaction by 25%. Supported risk and governance frameworks across delivery initiatives, contributing to a 20% reduction in project delays and budget overruns through structured issue management and control oversight.

Partnered with 20+ stakeholders across business, operations, technology, compliance, and product to deliver 8+ ISO 20022 and payment transformation initiatives, aligning priorities and resolving key delivery challenges

Contributed to solution design, release planning, and continuous improvement for payment products, supporting 15+ releases tied to ISO 20022 migration, message standardization, and process enhancements • Served as a payments SME for transformation programs, advising on SWIFT / cross-border payment flows, ISO

20022 impacts, and target-state process changes across 25+ markets / corridors across SEPA, CHAPS

Supported business case development for 5+ transformation initiatives, assessing problem statements, solution options, benefits, costs, and downstream implementation impacts for payment modernization programs • Advised senior stakeholders and leadership teams on solution options, business impacts, risks, and strategic

alignment for high-impact payment and ISO migration programs

Partnered with cross-functional teams to align delivery priorities with business strategy, regulatory



expectations, and client needs, supporting 8+ migration and payment change deliveries Led complex analysis across multiple workstreams to evaluate alternatives, define business requirements, and deliver solutions supporting enterprise-scale ISO 20022 readiness and payment transformation

Tata Consultancy Services Ltd, Mumbai Senior Quality Analyst

July 2010 - June 2015

Enhanced testing efficiency by 40% by creating 50 test cases from functional specifications and requirements. • Conducted extensive manual and automated testing, resulting in a marked increase in software accuracy and



customer satisfaction. Engaged regularly with cross-functional teams to address potential product issues early, reducing defects post- launch by 20%.

Communicated with clients to gather feedback and align QA goals with client expectations, enhancing the service delivery model.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Standard Chartered GBS/CBPR+ Initiative, Bengaluru

Delivered $1M+ annual project portfolio with strong governance, execution control, and on-time delivery • Achieved 99.9% STP in a large-scale CBPR+ / ISO 20022 migration across 25 markets • Reduced project delays and budget overruns by 20% through stronger risk management and governance controls

Standard Chartered GBS/Cross Border Payment/ACH Automation, Chennai

Reduced cross-border transaction costs from $50 to $1 across 40+ corridors through payment rail redesign and



ACH enablement. Improved client satisfaction and operational efficiency by 25% through ACH automation and payment process transformation

EXPERTISE AND SKILLS

Payments Domain: Cross-Border Payments| CBPR+| ACH| Real-Time Payments|P2P Payments | Request-to-Pay |Liquidity Management| Cash Management | SEPA Messaging & Standards: ISO 20022 |SWIFT | Payment Message Flows| Routing Logic| Field Mapping| Message Validation| Business Analysis: Requirements Gathering| BRD | FRD |User Stories| Gap Analysis| Feasibility Assessment| Traceability Matrix |UAT/SIT Support |APIs| Delivery & Governance: Agile| SDLC |STLC |Release Planning |Defect Management| Risk & Control| Stakeholder Management| Project Governance | Tools: Jira | Confluence| SQL |Hive |Data Visualization|

EDUCATION

PGDM, IT Systems (2015- 2017) Indian Institute of Management, Kozhikode

B.Tech, Electronics & Instrumentation (2006 - 2010) NIT, Rourkela

CERTIFICATIONS

Project Management Professional (PMP) by Project Management Institute (PMI)
